summary: Recommends storing playbooks, roles, inventory and variables in version control with meaningful commit messages to get an audit trail.
questions: Should I keep my Ansible inventory and playbooks in git?
How do I keep an audit trail of infrastructure automation changes?

answer_card.title: Keep Ansible content in version control
answer_card.answer_md: Store playbooks, roles, inventory and variable files in git (or another VCS) and commit changes with meaningful messages. This gives you an audit trail of when and why automation changed.
